name: workspace-terminal
title: Workspace Terminal
description: Open your VS Code Project Manager workspaces in your favorite terminal and auto-run a startup command.
author: 07JP27

commands.name: open-workspace
commands.title: Open Workspace
commands.subtitle: Workspace Terminal
commands.description: Search VS Code Project Manager workspaces and open them in a terminal.

preferences.name: vscodeApp
preferences.title: VS Code App
preferences.description: The VS Code-compatible app whose Project Manager data should be used.

preferences.name: projectManagerDataPath
preferences.title: Project Manager Data Path
preferences.description: Optional override for the Project Manager data directory or projects.json file.

preferences.name: terminalType
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal app used to open workspaces.

preferences.name: defaultCommand
preferences.title: Default Command
preferences.description: Command to run after opening a workspace. Leave empty to only open the terminal.

preferences.name: commandMode
preferences.title: Command Mode
preferences.description: How startup commands should be run.

preferences.name: reuseWindow
preferences.title: Reuse Existing Window
preferences.label: Open in an existing terminal window when supported
preferences.description: Best-effort behavior. Some terminals do not support window reuse.

preferences.name: groupProjectsByTag
preferences.title: Group Projects by Tag
preferences.description: Display projects in sections based on Project Manager tags.
preferences.label: Group projects by Project Manager tags

preferences.name: hideProjectsWithoutTag
preferences.title: Hide Projects Without Tags
preferences.description: Hide projects that do not have Project Manager tags.
preferences.label: Hide projects that do not have tags

preferences.name: hideProjectsNotEnabled
preferences.title: Hide Disabled Projects
preferences.description: Hide Project Manager entries where enabled is false.
preferences.label: Hide projects where enabled is false
